#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the original B23 acceptance scope without treating post-test collector rules as product requirements."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,collections,hashlib,json,re,zipfile
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--main',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--diagnostic',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--source',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--binding',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args()
def ident(b):return {'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'git_blob':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()}
def tree(rows):
 children=collections.defaultdict(list)
 for path,mode,sha in rows:
  bits=path.split('/')
  for i in range(1,len(bits)):children['/'.join(bits[:i-1])]
  children['/'.join(bits[:-1])].append((bits[-1],mode,sha))
 dirs={''}
 for path,mode,sha in rows:
  bits=path.split('/')
  for i in range(1,len(bits)):dirs.add('/'.join(bits[:i]))
 for d in dirs:
  if d:parent,_,name=d.rpartition('/');children[parent].append((name,'40000',None))
 computed={}
 def run(path):
  entries=[]
  for name,mode,sha in sorted(children[path],key=lambda x:(x[0]+('/' if x[1]=='40000' else '')).encode()):
   if mode=='40000':sha=run((path+'/' if path else '')+name)
   entries.append(mode.encode()+b' '+name.encode()+b'\0'+bytes.fromhex(sha))
  b=b''.join(entries);computed[path]=hashlib.sha1(b'tree '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest();return computed[path]
 return run(''),len(dirs)
diag=a.diagnostic/'b23';comp=a.diagnostic/'b23_compact'
artifacts=json.loads((a.diagnostic/'b23.artifacts.tool-return.original.json').read_bytes())['structuredContent']['artifacts']
zproof=[]
for name,dest,aid in [('b23.original.zip',diag,13476180428),('b23_compact.original.zip',comp,13475294944)]:
 b=(a.diagnostic/name).read_bytes();meta=next(x for x in artifacts if x['id']==aid)
 assert len(b)==meta['size_in_bytes'] and 'sha256:'+ident(b)['sha256']==meta['digest']
 with zipfile.ZipFile(a.diagnostic/name) as z:
  assert z.testzip() is None
  for n in z.namelist():assert (dest/n).read_bytes()==z.read(n)
  zproof.append({'id':aid,'zip':ident(b),'members':len(z.namelist())})
before=json.loads((diag/'source-before.json').read_bytes());after=json.loads((diag/'source-after.json').read_bytes())
assert before['status']==after['status']=='passed'
assert before['phase']=='before' and after['phase']=='after'
assert {k:v for k,v in before.items() if k!='phase'}=={k:v for k,v in after.items() if k!='phase'}
assert before['base_commit']=='67cc5c28c4adf82f6ef97c34a18b8b13f3ac27ed'
assert before['checkout_commit']=='b3bc3dcf5684568dd03f3667ecd2307b8577a0a6'
assert before['event_head']=='e63ed76c5d8ded046f97caffbdbe2883140e6032'
assert before['merge_parents']==[before['base_commit'],before['event_head']]
assert before['workflow_blob']=='d4b87c924a1dcc795e05aec1dd4e31854dcff687'
raw=(diag/'source-tree-before.ls-tree').read_bytes()
assert raw==(diag/'source-tree-after.ls-tree').read_bytes()
rows=[]
for entry in raw.split(b'\0'):
 if not entry:continue
 header,path=entry.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,sha=header.decode().split();assert kind in ('blob','commit')
 rows.append((path.decode(),mode,sha))
assert len(rows)==len({x[0] for x in rows})==10583
checkout,dirs=tree(rows)
assert checkout==before['checkout_tree']=='a6831e2607e718f1343b788e5b8062a171d50a71'
workflow='.github/workflows/hepta-b23-linux-app-server-original-gate.yml'
assert next(x[2] for x in rows if x[0]==workflow)==before['workflow_blob']
product=[x for x in rows if x[0]!=workflow]
product_root,_=tree(product)
assert product_root==before['base_tree']==before['original_tree_projection']=='3982ba56dc5a3f1da0c1de7ea57992f88125c359'
base=json.loads((a.main/'borrowed/authority/main67-full-tree.json').read_bytes())
assert sorted(product)==sorted((x['path'],x['mode'],x['sha']) for x in base['tree'] if x['type']!='tree')
pins=before['source_files'];assert len(pins)==14
for f in pins:
 b=(a.source/f['path']).read_bytes()
 assert ident(b)=={k:f[k] for k in ('bytes','git_blob','sha256')}
 assert next(x[2] for x in product if x[0]==f['path'])==f['git_blob']
lib=(a.source/'codex-rs/app-server/src/lib.rs').read_text()
assert 'runtime_options.install_shutdown_signal_handler && !single_client_mode' in lib
assert 'let single_client_mode = matches!(&transport, AppServerTransport::Stdio);' in lib
signals=(a.source/'codex-rs/app-server/src/shutdown_signals.rs').read_text()
assert '#[cfg(not(unix))]' in signals and 'tokio::signal::ctrl_c()' in signals
assert 'self.interrupt.recv()' in signals and 'self.terminate.recv()' in signals and 'self.hangup.recv()' in signals
bind=json.loads(a.binding.read_bytes())
assert len(bind['main']['attempts'])==len(bind['diagnostic']['attempts'])==8
for r in bind['comparison']:
 assert all(r['equalities'][k] for k in ['args','env','platform','semantic_input_graph_sha256','semantic_tool_graph_sha256'])
rows=[];names=[];pass_count=0;ignored_count=0
signal_names=['shutdown_signals::tests::first_sigterm_survives_cancelled_receive','shutdown_signals::tests::first_sighup_survives_cancelled_receive','shutdown_signals::tests::first_sigint_survives_cancelled_receive']
drain_names=['drain_handle_tests::requesting_drain_does_not_acknowledge_outstanding_turns','drain_handle_tests::repeated_drain_requests_preserve_the_real_completion_acknowledgement']
for n in range(1,9):
 rel=f'all-testlogs/codex-rs/app-server/app-server-unit-tests/shard_{n}_of_8/test.log';b=(diag/rel).read_bytes();s=b.decode('utf-8')
 native=next(r for r in bind['diagnostic']['attempts'] if r['shard']==n);cached=next(r for r in bind['main']['attempts'] if r['shard']==n)
 assert native['runner']=='remote' and native['cache_hit'] is False and cached['runner']=='remote cache hit' and cached['cache_hit'] is True
 assert ident(b)['sha256']==native['log_sha256']
 parsed=re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; \d+ measured; \d+ filtered out;.*$',s,re.M)
 assert len(parsed)==1 and int(parsed[0][1])==0
 passed,_,ignored=map(int,parsed[0]);pass_count+=passed;ignored_count+=ignored
 cases=re.findall(r'^test (.+) \.\.\. (ok|ignored(?:,.*)?)$',s,re.M);names.extend(cases)
 assert len([x for x in cases if x[1]=='ok'])==passed and len([x for x in cases if x[1].startswith('ignored')])==ignored
 rows.append({'shard':n,'log':ident(b),'passed':passed,'ignored':ignored,'native_action_digest':native['action_cache_digest'],'main_cached_log_sha256':cached['log_sha256'],'separate_results':native['log_sha256']!=cached['log_sha256']})
assert pass_count==307 and ignored_count==1 and len({x[0] for x in names})==308
for name in signal_names+drain_names:assert (name,'ok') in names
ignored=[n for n,s in names if s.startswith('ignored')]
assert ignored==['shutdown_signals::tests::retained_signal_child']
assert (diag/'original-bazel-exit-code.txt').read_bytes()==b'0\n'
assert (diag/'console-copy-exit-code.txt').read_bytes()==b'0\n'
bep=[json.loads(x) for x in (diag/'build-events.sanitized.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines()]
assert len(bep)==1924
results=[x for x in bep if 'testResult' in x]
assert len(results)==8 and {x['id']['testResult']['shard'] for x in results}==set(range(1,9))
assert all(x['testResult']['status']=='PASSED' and x['testResult']['executionInfo']['strategy']=='remote' and not x['testResult'].get('cachedLocally',False) for x in results)
manifest=json.loads((diag/'attempt-retention-manifest.json').read_bytes())
assert manifest['complete'] is False and manifest['original_bazel_exit']==0
errors=collections.Counter(x['kind'] for x in manifest['errors'])
assert errors=={'duplicate_event_id':2,'attempt_reference_unavailable':8}
for e in manifest['errors']:
 if e['kind']=='duplicate_event_id':assert 'fetch' in bep[e['event']]['id']
assert all(not (diag/f'all-testlogs/codex-rs/app-server/app-server-unit-tests/shard_{n}_of_8/test.xml').exists() for n in range(1,9))
jobs=json.loads(json.loads((a.diagnostic/'b23_jobs.tool-return.original.json').read_bytes())['structuredContent']['content'])['jobs']
job,=jobs;assert job['id']==127687422035 and job['conclusion']=='failure'
steps={s['name']:s['conclusion'] for s in job['steps']}
for key in ['Run the original full AppServer unit-test target','Verify source after the original invocation','Check for a clean worktree']:assert steps[key]=='success'
assert steps['Collect every produced attempt and gate artifact privacy']=='failure'
mainjobs=json.loads(json.loads((a.main/'original/main_blocking_jobs.tool-return.original.json').read_bytes())['structuredContent']['content'])['jobs']
mainjob=next(j for j in mainjobs if j['id']==127679861926);assert mainjob['conclusion']=='success'

 'prior_accepted_baseline':'Retain prior accepted physical baseline negative and prior five-case causal acceptance; not re-executed by this review.',
 'source':{'actual_checkout':before['checkout_commit'],'head':before['event_head'],'checkout_tree':checkout,'product_projection':product_root,'source_before_after_full_ls_tree_bytes_equal':True,'unchanged_product_leaves':10582,'directory_nodes':dirs,'unchanged_source_pins':pins,'configuration_disabled_and_stdio_guard_preserved':True,'nonunix_ctrl_c_branch_preserved':True},
 'original_diagnostic_artifacts':zproof,
